content: All three targets get docstrings via get_module_comment; GenericAliasMixin.update_content appends "alias of ..." after docstring. Expected output needs alias without docstring for two; get_module_comment returns non-None for all three (confirmed). Unsure why docstring not rendered—possibly reST parsing or analyzer caching? DataDocumenter.get_module_comment creates a fresh analyzer per call, so caching unlikely. Pending check: Python 3.6.9—typing._GenericAlias, _Union, Callable may not all be _GenericAlias; verify type classification. Next: run a command to inspect types in this Python version.
